               Packaging (Thumbnail/Title) - SOP
Note: Viewer’s first look at the thumbnail, then title (they make a decision to click or scroll away
in less than a second, that is milliseconds. So, before you think of adding too many elements to
the thumbnail and make the title 2 sentences long. Think twice.)
Goal: The goal is to get a click (10%+ CTR)

    1.​ Know who you’re getting to click (the audience)
           -​ Who will be looking at your packaging? Your audience
           -​ What are they looking for?
    2.​ Research:
           -​ Take lots of screenshots and notes on packaging from other and similar niche
               channels to yours
    3.​ Be Genuine, while trying to get attention. No fake attention (what you are claiming in
        packaging should be true)
           -​ Realistic & Genuine packaging = more clicks
           -​ Videos on youtube autoplay: so, the first 10 seconds of your video heavily
               impacts your CTR (video’s first 10 secs is the new packaging on youtube)
    4.​ The Packaging:
           a.​ Thumbnail:
                   i.​ Bright & Natural Colors
                  ii.​ Bold & Big Fonts (fewer text)
                 iii.​ Selling viewer’s on 1 BIG Idea
​       ​      Goal: The thumbnail should overall look realistic & believable
           b.​ Title:
                   i.​ Fewer characters (1 sentence)
                  ii.​ Title based on video topic (if you’re targeting broad or narrow audience)​
                       Broad: wider topics & shorter title​
                       Narrow: specific topic & longer/specific title
    5.​ Improving Packaging:
           -​ Your packaging will never be perfect, there is always something you can improve
               (get feedback on all the videos packaging, before finalizing)
           -​ Hitting Audience Desire > Design​
               A mediocrely designed packaging that makes our target viewers stop and
               consider clicking is always better than just a nice looking packaging.

Other Important Points To Remember:
   6.​ Duration of video, impacts the click
          -​ If the video length is 10 mins, don’t make the packaging look like a documentary
              video’s packaging.
          -​ The viewer should recognize the video type/length just from its packaging
   7.​ How was your last video? Did the viewer enjoy your last video? It impacts the click
